| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| Night Mode | Dims the ring for night. Turn it on manually or let the automatic setting do it. |
| Night Mode Behaviour | What night mode does when it activates: dim the ring or switch it off entirely. |
| Status Indicator | Whether the ring briefly shows device status events as coloured overlays. |
| Darkness Threshold | How dark the room must be before automatic night mode considers it night. |
| Identify Device | Flashes the ring so you can tell which device you are looking at. |
